# AI Wise Spaces

AI Wise Spaces builds AI-optimized websites for local businesses that want to be discovered by AI assistants, search engines, and local customers.

## Main Pages

- Homepage: https://aiwisespaces.com/
- Services: https://aiwisespaces.com/services
- Free Website Review: https://aiwisespaces.com/book-a-free-audit
- Pricing: https://aiwisespaces.com/pricing

## Services

- AI-ready website development
- Local AI visibility optimization
- JSON-LD schema setup
- llms.txt setup
- robots.txt optimization
- local service page creation
- website migration from WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace

- Lancaster, PA
- York, PA
- Harrisburg, PA
- Reading, PA
- Allentown, PA
- West Chester, PA

- Fairfax, DE
- Wilmington, DE
- United States

## Business Summary

AI Wise Spaces helps service businesses replace bloated website builders with fast, structured, AI-readable websites.
